newsitem.title: USA: US One and two units seek Chapter 11 bankruptcy.
newsitem.headline: US One and two units seek Chapter 11 bankruptcy.

text.p: US One Communications Corp and two subsidiaries filed for Chapter 11 protection late Thursday in the U.S. Bankruptcy Court in Delaware, court papers say.

On June 6, the company was placed in involuntary Chapter 7 bankruptcy by its major creditor, Lucent Technologies Inc, which listed a claim of $57.3 million for products and services. US One has asked the court to convert the involuntary case to a voluntary Chapter 11 and to grant the same status to US One Communications Services Corp and to US One Communications of New York Inc.

In court papers, Services listed assets of $82.4 million and liabilities of $116.2 million. The 20 largest unsecured creditors hold trade claims, with the largest being Lucent's claim of $51.9 million.
The New York subsidiary listed assets of $27.8 million, liabilities of $29.8 million, and the same unsecured creditors as Services.
US One was founded in 1994 "to build a nationwide telephone company," court papers say. The companies are headquartered in Dallas.
Calls to US One were not returned.
